header.running_head: The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for the Four Khulafaa

blocks.text: they heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, "Am I not closer to the Mu'mineen than they are to themselves?" When the Sahabah (RA) admitted that he really was, Rasulullaah ﷺ took hold of Hadhrat Ali (RA)'s hand saying, "This man should be the friend of anyone who claims that I am his friend." Rasulullaah ﷺ then made du'aa for Hadhrat Ali (RA) saying, "O Allaah! Befriend those who befriend him, be the enemy of those who are his enemies, love those who love him, despise who despise him, assist those who assist him and do not assist those who fail to assist him."[^1]

Another narration from Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) states that Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa for Hadhrat Ali (RA) saying, "O Allaah! Assist him and assist others through him, have mercy on him and have mercy on others though him, help him and help others though him. O Allaah! Befriend those who are his friends and be the enemy of those who are his enemies."[^2]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa for him saying, "O Allaah! Keep his tongue firm (on the truth) and guide his heart."[^3]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ's du'aa for Hadhrat Ali (RA) was, "O Allaah! Guide him in passing judgement."[^4]
The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) and Hadhrat Zubayr bin Awwaam (RA)
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) narrates that the du'aa Rasulullaah ﷺ made for Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) was, "O Allaah! Make his arrows travel straight, accept his du'aas and love him."[^5]
Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) himself narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa for him saying, "O Allaah! Accept the du'aa of Sa'd whenever he makes du'aa to You."[^6]
Hadhrat Zubayr bin Awwaam (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa for him, for his children and for his progeny.[^7]
The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ made for the members of his Family

Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) who was the wife of Rasulullaah ﷺ narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once told Hadhrat Faatima (RA) to come to him with her husband and her two sons. When they arrived, Rasulullaah ﷺ threw over them a blanket that Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) was sitting on, which they had received as booty from Khaybar.
